items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'Penguins are birds that live in cold places. They cannot fly, but they are excellent swimmers.'

Text B: 'Penguins eat fish and other sea animals. They can dive deep underwater to catch their food.'

What is one thing both texts have in common?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Both texts say penguins cannot fly

choices.label: B
choices.text: Both texts are about penguins and describe how they live in or near the ocean

choices.label: C
choices.text: Both texts say penguins eat fish

choices.label: D
choices.text: Both texts say penguins live in cold places

items.explanation: Option B is the most complete similarity: both texts are about penguins and both describe behaviors related to living near the ocean (swimming in Text A, diving and eating sea animals in Text B). Options A and D only capture what one text says.

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'The Grand Canyon was carved by the Colorado River over millions of years. It is more than a mile deep in places.'

Text B: 'Millions of tourists visit the Grand Canyon each year. It is one of the most popular national parks in the United States.'

What does Text A tell you that Text B does NOT?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The Grand Canyon is in the United States

choices.label: B
choices.text: The Grand Canyon is very deep and was carved by the Colorado River

choices.label: C
choices.text: The Grand Canyon is a popular place to visit

choices.label: D
choices.text: Many tourists visit the Grand Canyon

items.explanation: Only Text A tells you how the Grand Canyon formed (carved by the Colorado River) and how deep it is. Text B focuses on tourism. Options C and D describe information from Text B only.

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'Bald eagles are large birds of prey. They have a white head and a powerful hooked beak.'

Text B: 'Bald eagles are the national symbol of the United States. They appear on coins, government buildings, and the presidential seal.'

If a student wants to learn what a bald eagle looks like, which text should they read?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Text B, because it tells you about the eagle's white head

choices.label: B
choices.text: Text A, because it describes the eagle's physical appearance

choices.label: C
choices.text: Text B, because it describes the eagle as a symbol

choices.label: D
choices.text: Neither text describes what the eagle looks like

items.explanation: Text A describes the eagle's physical features: its large size, white head, and hooked beak. Text B focuses on the eagle as a national symbol. Only Text A answers the question about appearance.

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'Volcanoes can be found on land and on the ocean floor. When underwater volcanoes build up enough lava over thousands of years, they can rise above the water's surface and form islands.'

Text B: 'Volcanoes can be very destructive. The eruption of Mount Vesuvius in 79 CE buried the Roman city of Pompeii under ash and rock. Thousands of people died and the city was preserved under the ash for nearly 2,000 years.'

Which statement BEST describes how the two texts are different?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Text A describes how volcanoes form islands while Text B describes a specific historical volcanic disaster

choices.label: B
choices.text: Text A says volcanoes are dangerous while Text B says they are helpful

choices.label: C
choices.text: Text A is about ocean volcanoes and Text B is about land volcanoes, and they have nothing in common

choices.label: D
choices.text: Text A describes destruction and Text B describes island formation

items.explanation: Text A explains a process (how underwater volcanoes form islands) while Text B tells the story of a specific historical eruption and its consequences. Option B reverses the content incorrectly. Option D swaps which text contains which information.

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'Sojourner Truth was born into slavery in New York around 1797. She escaped to freedom in 1826 and later became a well-known speaker and activist who fought for the rights of enslaved people.'

Text B: 'Sojourner Truth also fought for women's right to vote. In 1851, she gave a famous speech called 'Ain't I a Woman?' at a women's rights conference in Ohio. She continued speaking out for equality until her death in 1883.'

What is one similarity between these two texts? Which gives more information about Sojourner Truth's work for women's rights?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Both texts say she escaped slavery; Text A gives more information about women's rights

choices.label: B
choices.text: Both texts describe her as a person who fought for equality; Text B gives more information about women's rights

choices.label: C
choices.text: Both texts describe the same speech; Text B focuses on her escape from slavery

choices.label: D
choices.text: Both texts say she was born in Ohio; Text A gives more information about women's rights

items.explanation: Both texts portray Truth as someone who fought for equality (enslaved people in Text A, women in Text B). Text B gives more information about women's rights by describing her famous speech and her continued advocacy. Text A does not mention women's rights.

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'The ocean covers about 71 percent of Earth's surface. It regulates the planet's temperature by absorbing heat from the sun and distributing it around the world.'

Text B: 'Humans have explored less than 20 percent of Earth's oceans. The deep sea remains mysterious, with new species of fish, worms, and other creatures still being discovered every year.'

A student says both texts are trying to convince readers that the ocean is important. Is this accurate for both texts?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Yes, both texts argue that we must protect the ocean from pollution

choices.label: B
choices.text: No, both texts only give facts about the ocean's size

choices.label: C
choices.text: Partially. Text A shows the ocean's importance for climate, while Text B focuses on how much is still unknown and being discovered

choices.label: D
choices.text: Yes, both texts focus on undiscovered ocean species

items.explanation: Text A shows the ocean's importance for regulating Earth's temperature. Text B focuses on how unexplored the ocean is and the ongoing discovery of new species. Neither text directly argues for ocean protection (ruling out A), and they address different aspects of the ocean (ruling out B and D).

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'Ancient Egyptians developed one of the world's first writing systems called hieroglyphics. They used over 700 symbols to represent sounds, words, and ideas. Scribes spent years learning to read and write hieroglyphics.'

Text B: 'Ancient Egyptians were also skilled mathematicians. They developed a system for counting and measuring that allowed them to build enormous structures with great precision. Historians believe Egyptian math influenced Greek and later European mathematics.'

Both texts describe achievements of ancient Egypt. A student says these texts are about completely different topics. Another student says they both contribute to the same main idea. Which student is right?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The first student is right because writing and math are completely separate subjects

choices.label: B
choices.text: The second student is right because both texts describe advanced intellectual achievements of ancient Egyptian civilization, even though the specific subjects differ

choices.label: C
choices.text: Both students are right because the texts are both different and the same

choices.label: D
choices.text: Neither student is right because the texts are really about Greek mathematics, not Egypt

items.explanation: The second student is right. While the specific subjects differ (writing vs. math), both texts show that ancient Egyptians developed advanced intellectual systems that influenced other civilizations. The overarching idea in both texts is the sophistication of ancient Egyptian civilization, which makes them complementary rather than unrelated.

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'Scientists have discovered that ocean temperatures are rising. Warmer water holds less oxygen, which affects fish and other marine life. Many species are migrating to cooler waters near the poles.'

Text B: 'Scientists have discovered that rising ocean temperatures are also causing coral bleaching. When water is too warm, corals expel the algae that give them color and nutrients. Without the algae, corals starve and turn white.'

Both texts describe the same cause. Evaluate which text gives more alarming information and explain why reading both texts together reveals a more serious problem than either one describes alone.

choices.label: A
choices.text: Text A is more alarming because fish migrating is more visible than coral bleaching

choices.label: B
choices.text: Text B is more alarming because coral bleaching sounds more dramatic, but together the texts only describe minor problems

choices.label: C
choices.text: Text B is more alarming on its own because it describes corals dying, but together both texts reveal that rising ocean temperatures cause damage to multiple types of marine life across different habitats, making the overall problem much larger

choices.label: D
choices.text: Both texts are equally alarming and say exactly the same things using different words

items.explanation: Text B describes corals starving and dying, which is alarming. But together, both texts reveal that rising ocean temperatures harm open-water fish (migration, less oxygen) AND coral reef ecosystems (bleaching, starvation). The combined picture shows damage across multiple marine systems simultaneously, which describes a far larger and more serious problem than either text reveals alone.
